moreText: Markets before the crowds are completely different places — the vendors are still setting up, the prices haven't changed for tourists yet, and you can actually talk to the people selling things. Buy something. Eat it there.

moreText: The city at full tilt is a specific kind of pleasure — noise, heat, movement, smell, everyone operating on their own errand. Walking without a destination through a city at peak energy is its own form of meditation once you stop resisting it.
